title: Host's Mars UFO photo tweet turns out to be a rock

tellings.quote: I tweeted a thing. It was like, you know, this little um picture of like a UFO on Mars or whatever.

plain: Michels once posted a picture on Twitter that seemed to show a UFO on the surface of Mars, and it turned out to be a rock. He tells this on himself, briefly, in an episode with a guest named Luke Caverns, calling it "this little um picture of like a UFO on Mars or whatever."
